comparison.json, written by servtuner compare: the experiment comparison. Runs with the same knobs are repeats of one configuration; each configuration's objectives carry a confidence interval across repeats (throughput objectives) or a bootstrap interval over the pooled per-request records (latency objectives). A configuration wins only when its interval does not overlap the runner-up's, or, with single samples, when it leads by more than twice the noise floor. Recomputable from the bundles.

Schema file: `schema/json/comparison.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `049c80278666`.

## Definitions

### objectiveName

The slo\_\* objectives divide each run's SLO-max RPS by the configuration's size: ready replicas, recommended CPU request cores per replica times replicas, or GPUs. p95\_ttft\_at\_target\_rps is read at the stage offering analysis.target\_rps.

Type: `"slo_max_rps"`, `"slo_rps_per_replica"`, `"slo_rps_per_core"`, `"slo_rps_per_gpu"`, `"tokens_per_s_per_gpu"`, `"p95_ttft_at_target_rps"`, `"infra_cost_per_1k_requests"`, `"infra_cost_per_1m_output_tokens"`, `"cost_per_1k_requests"`, `"cost_per_1m_output_tokens"`

### objectiveDirection

Type: `"maximize"`, `"minimize"`

### comparisonConfidence

High needs at least 3 repeats of every configuration, a significant result and full catalog coverage; medium is a significant single-sample or two-repeat result; low is anything weaker.

Type: `"high"`, `"medium"`, `"low"`

### comparisonIssueCode

Type: `"workload_differs"`, `"target_type_differs"`, `"hardware_differs"`, `"arrival_differs"`, `"ladder_differs"`, `"slos_differ"`, `"experiment_differs"`, `"too_few_configurations"`, `"not_factorial"`, `"coverage_incomplete"`

### comparisonIssue

| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `code`    | [comparisonIssueCode](/reference/schemas/comparison/#comparisonissuecode) | Yes      |             |
| `message` | `string`                                                                  | Yes      |             |

### comparability

Whether the runs measured the same thing. Different workloads, target types, arrival processes, ladders or SLOs make the comparison not comparable, and no configuration is recommended. Different hardware is an issue but stays comparable, because the hardware may be the knob.

| Field             | Type                                                                       | Required | Description                                                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `is_comparable`   | `boolean`                                                                  | Yes      |                                                                                     |
| `workload_hash`   | `string`                                                                   | No       |                                                                                     |
| `workload_preset` | [presetRef](/reference/runspec/#presetref)                                 | No       | The workload preset every run named; absent when they named none or different ones. |
| `target_type`     | [targetType](/reference/runspec/#targettype)                               | No       |                                                                                     |
| `issues`          | array of [comparisonIssue](/reference/schemas/comparison/#comparisonissue) | Yes      |                                                                                     |

### excludedRun

| Field    | Type     | Required | Description |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `run_id` | `string` | Yes      |             |
| `reason` | `string` | Yes      |             |

### intervalMethod

repeats: mean across runs with a Student t interval; bootstrap: percentile bootstrap over the pooled per-request records; single\_sample: one run, no interval.

Type: `"repeats"`, `"bootstrap"`, `"single_sample"`

### objectiveInterval

An objective's value with its 95% interval, or the reason it is unavailable; never both. ci\_low and ci\_high are absent for single\_sample.

| Field                | Type                                                            | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`              | `number`                                                        | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `ci_low`             | `number`                                                        | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `ci_high`            | `number`                                                        | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `method`             | [intervalMethod](/reference/schemas/comparison/#intervalmethod) | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `is_lower_bound`     | `boolean`                                                       | No       | True when some run never failed its SLOs within its ladder, so its SLO-max is the top stage's rate and the true value may be higher. A lower-bound runner-up cannot be beaten; extend the ladder. Default: `false`. |
| `samples`            | `integer`                                                       | Yes      | Runs for repeats and single\_sample; requests for bootstrap. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                    |
| `unavailable_reason` | `string`                                                        | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `is_upper_bound`     | `boolean`                                                       | No       | The same censoring for an objective where less is better, such as a cost per request: the true value may be lower. An upper-bound runner-up cannot be beaten either. Default: `false`.                              |

Exactly which fields are allowed together is restricted further by the schema.

### knobRecommendation
